edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.almenaŭ: User adopted 至少: represent at least explicitly, retaining all existing meanings and decomposition.
rationale.forniks: User adopted 拱ᶠ: represent anatomical arch/vault without restricting it to the brain; retain cerebral, conjunctival and vaginal meanings.
rationale.karen: User adopted 船底: distinguish the submerged lower hull from kil (keel), preserving anatomical and botanical metaphor senses.
rationale.naŭz: User adopted 恶心: retain physical nausea and figurative disgust without requiring actual vomiting; preserve vom=吐.
